items.title: CPI and Fed Policy Focus
points: August consumer price index (CPI, the rate at which prices across the economy rise) due Friday; core CPI expected at 2.4%, down from prior month
Report follows Thursday's producer price index (PPI, wholesale inflation paid by businesses) and will influence the Fed's September rate decision (whether to raise, cut, or hold interest rates)
Holiday-shortened trading week reduces liquidity and may amplify market reaction to inflation data
ECB announces its own policy decision Thursday
Bond market volatility raises concerns about potential instability ahead of major data and the Fed decision

items.title: Major Tech Earnings This Week
points: Oracle and Adobe report earnings Thursday, among the week's most closely watched results
Nvidia scheduled to present at the Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference
Results will signal health of enterprise software demand and AI infrastructure spending

items.title: Boeing Operations Improve Despite Headwinds
points: July deliveries reached 53 aircraft (39 from the 737 MAX family, 10 from the 787), slightly down sequentially but above historical average
Gross orders were 38, net orders 30 worth $3.3 billion in July; activity subdued but stable year-over-year
Stock declined 10% amid Middle East tensions and dollar strength concerns, but management focused on sustainable production growth
Company approaching a cleaner operational position with potential for production increases and new aircraft certifications supporting future cash flow

items.title: NFL Season Kickoff Boosts Betting Stocks
points: NFL season kicks off Wednesday, boosting DraftKings and Flutter Entertainment shares

items.title: Broadcom's Staggering AI Semiconductor Demand
points: Revenue surged 86% year-over-year with adjusted earnings per share up 96%, both beating analyst estimates
AI semiconductor revenue alone tripled to $16.7B in the quarter

CEO Hock Tan confirmed $350B in cumulative AI chip shipments to six key hyperscaler (cloud providers like Meta and Google that run massive data centers) customers across 2027-2028, calling it achievable with high confidence

items.title: Broader AI Infrastructure Boom Across Hardware Vendors
points: Dell issued a revenue outlook $25B above Wall Street estimates
Nvidia forecast 70% annual sales growth, with potential for over 100% growth if component supply constraints were lifted
HPE generated $12.21B revenue (up 34% year-over-year) with record backlog for AI servers and networking gear, yet stock fell on profit-taking despite raised full-year guidance of 37% growth

points: Brian Sozzi will conduct roughly 20 C-suite interviews at Goldman Sachs' Communacopia tech conference in San Francisco starting September 8
Coverage may include insights on upcoming IPOs from OpenAI and Anthropic
Real-time reporting will appear on Opening Bid throughout the conference

issues.subject: Morning Brief: These AI numbers are getting crazy

headlines: Broadcom's AI chip revenue tripled to $16.7B last quarter with 86% overall revenue growth, signaling hyperscaler (cloud providers like Meta and Google) demand for custom semiconductors remains extraordinary.
Dell raised guidance $25B above estimates, Nvidia projects 70% sales growth, and HPE beat expectations with 34% revenue growth, all driven by enterprise appetite for AI infrastructure.
Broadcom CEO projects shipping $350B in AI semiconductors to six major customers over the next two years, indicating the AI investment cycle is far from peaking despite skeptics' claims.
